runs.title: Fine-tuning runs
runs.subtitle: Each run is a Meep² training job on a GPU node, in that node's queue.
runs.loadFailed: The runs could not be loaded
runs.none: No runs yet. Start a fine-tune to train a model on your data.
runs.name: Run

method.qloraHelp: The base model in 4-bit. Needs the least memory.
method.loraHelp: The base model in 16-bit. Meep²'s default.
method.fp8Help: The frozen weights held in FP8: less memory, faster on GPUs with FP8 tensor cores. The plan refuses it where the GPU has none.
method.nvfp4Help: The frozen weights and their inputs held in NVFP4, on Blackwell's FP4 tensor cores: about twice as fast as 16 bits on a DGX Spark. The plan refuses it where the GPU has none.

newRun.loadFailed: The models, datasets or nodes could not be loaded
newRun.title: New fine-tune
newRun.subtitle: Choose a model and a dataset. Meep²'s auto mode decides how to train them, and says why.
newRun.name: Name
newRun.noModels: No model can be fine-tuned yet. Mirror a BF16 text model in Thinkube Control first.
newRun.noDatasets: No dataset is ready to train on yet: import or upload one, and map its columns.
newRun.nodeLoaded: Loaded here now: {{models}}. Training shares the GPU with them.
newRun.registerHelp: Merge the result into a full model that the LLM Gateway can serve.
newRun.settingsHelp: How long to train, and what the job may use on the node.
newRun.startFailed: The run could not be created
newRun.previewTitle: The first example, as the model trains on it
newRun.previewHelp: Its turns through the base model's chat template.
newRun.previewText: Text, as the dataset maps it.
newRun.whenHelp: One training runs on a node at a time, in the order of the node's queue.

when.now: When the runs before it on the node have ended.
when.slots: Only in the node's slots, when its models are unloaded for training.

newRun.acrossSlotsHelp: A run longer than the slot starts anyway, pauses at the slot's end and goes on in the next one. Otherwise it waits for a slot long enough.
newRun.planHelp: Meep² loads the model on {{node}}, measures it with your data, and decides how to train it. Nothing is trained yet.
newRun.planning: Meep² is planning on the node…
newRun.revising: Meep² is planning from an earlier plan's measurements, without loading the model…
newRun.planWaits: The plan waits for {{node}} to be free.
newRun.holdout: Hold out a share of the training split
newRun.evaluationHelp: The run measures the loss on examples it does not train on, about ten times over the run.
newRun.advancedHelp: Hardware is auto mode's choice: the plan job asks for the base model's 16-bit weights plus 8 GB, the training job for the memory Meep²'s plan states, and the node gives its default CPU cores.
newRun.setHardware: Set the jobs' memory and CPU cores myself
newRun.milestonesHelp: Keep the adapter at a share of the training and, with an evaluation set, score what the model writes at each one.
newRun.milestoneGrowthHelp: Leave empty for milestones at equal distances. A factor above 1 spaces them out: the first after the percentage above, and each distance between two milestones this factor times the one before (1.5 with a first distance of 500 steps: steps 500, 1250, 2375, ...), so they come often at the start, where scores move fast, and seldom later.
newRun.milestoneGroupHelp: Each value is scored apart, such as a translation direction.
newRun.milestoneSourceHelp: The source alone, without the instruction: an answer is cut at twice its tokens + 32. Without it, the prompt's last message counts.
newRun.milestoneMetricsHelp: The scoring service's metrics, separated by commas.
newRun.milestoneWeightsHelp: A choice run's milestones can be answered on other weights than the training's, such as QLoRA's NF4 base, which a 24 GB GPU serves: Meep² loads a second copy of the base so and copies the adapter and the head into it at each milestone.
newRun.preprocessing: Meep² is preprocessing the data on {{node}}: tokenized, checked and cut once…
newRun.preprocessWaits: The preprocessing job is being started.

run.stopping: The training stops at its next step and keeps a checkpoint

run.preprocessFound: Found: made before from the same data and settings
run.millRun: Its progress, samples and log in Mill

chat.title: Ask the models
chat.help: The same question to the fine-tuned model, its base model and its GGUF and NVFP4 exports, each in its own conversation. Each must be served by the LLM Gateway.
chat.loadFirst: Serve at least one of the two models to ask it.

export.title: Export to GGUF
export.help: Convert the registered model to a GGUF file with llama.cpp's converter. The LLM Gateway serves it on llama.cpp, and Ollama and other llama.cpp tools read it. The conversion needs no GPU.
export.running: Converting and uploading; this takes some minutes.
export.done: {{id}} is in the model catalogue, served by llama.cpp.

compare.help: Up to four runs on one axis. Pick runs on the Runs page.
compare.noPoints: These runs have logged nothing yet.

queue.notConnected: The queue cannot start jobs yet

queue.workerProblem: The queue's worker reports a problem

plan.title: Meep²'s plan
plan.memoryYours: The jobs ask for {{gb}} GB: your choice.
plan.memoryMeep: The training job asks for {{gb}} GB, as Meep²'s plan states: {{reason}}.
plan.memoryUnsized: Meep²'s plan cannot size the training job: {{reason}}. Set its memory to queue it.

slots.title: Slots
slots.subtitle: A slot is a node and a recurring time window. A run queued for slots trains only inside a slot of its node, when the Scheduler gives it the node's GPUs by its priority.
slots.loadFailed: The slots could not be loaded
slots.worker: The queue's access to Thinkube Control
slots.workerHelp: The queue gives runs to the Scheduler when nobody is signed in. For that it keeps a Thinkube Control API token of the person who connects it, and acts with that person's rights.
slots.disconnectConfirm: The token is revoked in Thinkube Control. The queue starts nothing until it is connected again; running trainings go on.
slots.listHelp: A run queued for slots starts only inside a slot of its node. At the slot's end, the running training pauses with a checkpoint, and goes on in the next slot.
slots.none: No slots yet. Runs queued for slots wait until their node has one.
slots.addHelp: The days are the days the window starts on.
slots.endHelp: An end before the start is on the next day. An end equal to the start is a whole day.
slots.deleteConfirm: If the slot is open now, its runs pause at once.

priority.title: Priority
priority.runHelp: 1 is the highest. Forge's runs on the node of a higher or the same priority make the run wait, and its runs of a lower one are paused for it; the Scheduler weighs it against the other work on the node, by the priorities on its Priorities page.

nvfp4.title: Export to NVFP4
nvfp4.help: Quantize the registered model to NVFP4 with NVIDIA's TensorRT Model Optimizer, calibrated on rows of the split the run trained on, and publish it for vLLM. NVFP4 is computed by Blackwell GPUs (compute capability 10.0 and higher), such as the DGX Spark; the gateway serves it only there.
nvfp4.noNode: No GPU node of the cluster computes NVFP4: it needs compute capability 10.0 or higher.
nvfp4.rowsHelp: Drawn with a fixed seed from the split the run trained on.
nvfp4.running: Calibrating, quantizing and uploading; this takes some minutes.
nvfp4.done: {{id}} is in the model catalogue, served by vLLM on Blackwell GPUs.
